channel.title: Gauge
channel.description: Updates for Gauge, a private system monitor for macOS.

item.title: Gauge 0.3.0
item.description:
• Gauge lives in the menu bar: CPU up top, and a click shows all six vitals and the top notice. Closing the window keeps Gauge running; turn it off in Settings.
  • The disk channel shows used space, so a fuller bar means the same thing on every channel.
  • Game servers, such as Minecraft on Java, are listed on Projects but no longer counted as dev servers.
  • The status bar shows Gauge's own CPU and memory.
  • Lighter animations: only the readout and the scale fill move when a reading changes.
  • Tests for formatting, process grouping, dev-server detection, notices and history.
